learning_outcomes.title: Equations, identities and contradictions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: A true constant statement is an identity; a false one means no solution.

questions.instruction: Solve the equation. Check your solution.
questions.stem: Solve the equation. Check your solution. 2(r+6)=4(r+4)

parts.prompt: Show your steps. State if there is one solution, no solution, or an identity.

answer.model_answer_and_marking: 2r+12=4r+16 ⇒ −4=2r ⇒ r=−2. Both sides equal 8. Distribution (3), collection/simplification (3), conclusion and check (4).

questions.stem: Solve the equation. Check your solution. -5(3-q)+4=5q-11

parts.prompt: Show your steps. State if there is one solution, no solution, or an identity.

answer.model_answer_and_marking: −15+5q+4=5q−11 ⇒ 5q−11=5q−11. Identity: every real q is a solution. Distribution (3), collection/simplification (3), conclusion and check (4).
